title: Alerting
description: Route findings to destinations and inspect the delivery log. A route references a destination by name; the credential lives in the wired transport.

routes.intro: Each route sends matching findings to one destination, in priority order.
routes.emptyHint: Add a route to send matching findings to a destination.

deleteDialog.title: Delete route?
deleteDialog.description: This removes the route “{{name}}”. Findings it matched will no longer be delivered by it.

dialog.title: New route
dialog.subtitle: Match findings and send them to a destination. Blank match lists match everything.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.destinationHint: A provisioned destination (name only — its credential lives in the transport).
dialog.enabledHint: A disabled route matches nothing until re-enabled.
dialog.matchTypesHint: Select one or more event types. Descriptions come from the server catalog.

deliveries.noRead: You do not have permission to view deliveries.
deliveries.intro: The recorded delivery attempts (read-only). Use a route's test to probe a destination.

outbox.noRead: You do not have permission to view the outbox.
outbox.intro: The durable outbox: notifications the engine still owes, those it has already delivered, and the dead letters it gave up on. Requeuing one asks for a new delivery attempt; it does not deliver.
outbox.emptyDeadHint: A notification lands here when its retries are exhausted or the destination refused it permanently. Nothing has been given up on.
outbox.emptyHint: Choose another status, or check the routes tab to confirm a route matches the findings you expect.

redeliver.queuedHint: The notification is queued again. The next delivery run makes the attempt — it has not been delivered yet.
redeliver.inFlight: Not requeued: this notification is already in flight to {{destination}}.
redeliver.gone: Not requeued: this notification is not in this tenant's outbox. It may have been removed, or belong to another tenant.
redeliver.forbidden: Not requeued: the control plane refused the request for {{destination}}. Requeuing needs the notify route admin permission; a policy or a scoped restriction can also refuse it.
redeliver.consent: Not requeued: the recording notice for this surface has not been acknowledged yet. Acknowledge it and try again — this is not a missing permission.
redeliver.stepUp: Not requeued yet: the requeue for {{destination}} needs a verified session. Complete the verification and try again.
redeliver.failed: The requeue for {{destination}} failed. The notification was not queued again.

confirm.title: Requeue this notification?
confirm.description: This asks for a new delivery attempt to {{destination}}. The recipient may receive it more than once if an earlier attempt arrived after all.

evaluate.title: Test signal
evaluate.caption: Predicate evaluation only; deduplication and throttling are not simulated.
evaluate.name: Route

history.title: Revision history — {{name}}
history.description: Chronological, append-only snapshots of this notification route.
history.selectTwo: Select two revisions to compare their snapshots.
history.restoreDescription: Restore the selected route configuration for {{name}}?
